title: Geometric reduction of the upper constant quotient realization to the lower tower level
statement: Under the consecutive adic tower hypotheses and a supplied upper constant quotient model isomorphism, the lower constant quotient realization of the derived scalar extension of the upper model is isomorphic to the pullback of the lower tower level.

source.place: Tag 09C6, consecutive quotient balancing before the lower model is introduced

proof.text: Pull the normalization isomorphism from level n+1 to level n along the pointed etale chart, paste it with the canonical quotient scalar comparison and the constant realization derived scalar extension comparison, and transport it across the supplied upper model isomorphism. Completion evaluation commutes with the quotient projections, so the composite has the displayed source and target.

theorem constantAdicQuotient_model_realization_reduction
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ X)
    {A : Type (u + 1)} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (M : AdicTower X d) (n : ℕ) (W : Y.Etale) (_w : W.left)
    (E' : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (AdicCompletion d.ideal A ⧸
      (d.ideal.map (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A))) ^ (n + 1 + 1))))
    (e' : Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d (n + 1)).obj E' ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op (n + 1)))).obj (M.level (n + 1)))) :
    Nonempty ((constantAdicQuotientRealization (W.hom ≫ g) d n).obj
      ((CategoryTheory.ConstantScalarRealization.moduleDerivedExtension
        (Ideal.Quotient.factor
          (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (I := d.ideal.map
            (algebraMap A (AdicCompletion d.ideal A)))
            (Nat.le_succ (n + 1))))).obj E') ≅
      (adicTowerPullback (W.hom ≫ g)
        ((pbcAdicRings X d).obj (op n))).obj (M.level n))
